_readme: Curated price pins. Applied AFTER the sheet match in build-price-map.mjs,
so a generic sheet row can never mis-price a specific ref.
A pin also CREATES the entry when the sheet has no matching row at all.
price_cop is COP as an integer; unit is the label shown to the customer.
Source values must name where the figure came from - never invent one.
2026-11-03: los 4 pins CORNISA (14999 'cliente - nuevos') fueron ELIMINADOS: la hoja
oct 2026 trae CODIGOS exactos para esas refs (9500) y la hoja manda. Con matching
por codigo los pins solo pisarian el precio nuevo de la hoja.
